verdict.rationale: Grafana Cloud documents built-in AI-powered capabilities, Grafana Assistant and Investigations, plus natural-language understanding of production systems. Its Knowledge Graph continuously generates insights on saturation, errors, anomalies and failures. The evidence is marketing-level, though: it does not describe how the Assistant produces insights or suggestions, does not say whether Knowledge Graph insights are AI-generated, and appears limited to Grafana Cloud. missing for 10: detailed docs on Assistant-generated insights and actionable suggestions, explicit confirmation that the insights are AI-generated, availability beyond Grafana Cloud, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Includes AI-powered capabilities for engineering teams, including Grafana Assistant, Investigations, Agent Observability, and more.
Understand production systems faster using natural language
It continuously generates insights that highlight saturation, errors, anomalies, failures, and configuration changes
generating insights about issues, and connecting metrics, logs, and traces in a unified workflow
